title: Wealth effects of going private for senior securities

rival_explanations: leverage changes drive the abnormal bond returns

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ firms undertaking going-private buyouts)

data_sources.name: Moody's Manuals (Moody's security descriptions, covenants, and bond ratings)
SEC filings (proxy statements, 10-K reports, pro forma capitalization in buyout filings)

analyses.label: Table 2 - Sample distribution of leverage ratios before and after buyouts (descriptive)
analyses.sample: 113 AMEX, NYSE, and NASDAQ firms with available leverage measures (30 NASDAQ, 83 AMEX/NYSE), 1974-1985

key_ivs.name: going-private buyout
key_ivs.measure: level and change in leverage ratio upon the buyout

analyses.label: Table 3 - Capital structure before and after going-private buyouts (descriptive book-value proportions)

dv.name: capital structure proportions by security type
dv.source: SEC filings (balance sheet, pro forma capitalization)

key_ivs.name: going-private buyout
key_ivs.measure: change in capital structure proportions at the buyout

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: 404 securities (387 debt, 17 preferred) outstanding at 113 buyouts

dv.name: security disposition outcome
dv.measure: book value (thousands of dollars) and number of issues in each outcome category: fully/partially redeemed for cash, exchanged for other securities, remain outstanding without renegotiation, timing of payments renegotiated

key_ivs.name: security type
key_ivs.measure: private vs public, convertible vs nonconvertible, protected vs unprotected debt and preferred stock

analyses.label: Table 5 - Index model (market/bond-index model) estimates for common stock, debt, and preferred stock
analyses.sample: 197 NYSE/AMEX common stocks, 90 NASDAQ common stocks, 30 convertible debt, 25 convertible preferred, 68 nonconvertible debt, 12 nonconvertible preferred; estimated by weighted least squares (WLS)

dv.name: security return
dv.measure: return to the jth common stock or security (r_jt); single-day and multi-day returns

key_ivs.name: market return
key_ivs.measure: value-weighted NYSE/AMEX market return for listed stock and equal-weighted NASDAQ market return for NASDAQ stock (r_mt)

key_ivs.name: bond index return
key_ivs.measure: return to the Dow Jones bond index (r_bt)

analyses.label: Table 6 Panel A - Abnormal returns before buyout announcements (preannouncement period, event study)
analyses.sample: events by security type (common stock, convertible debt, convertible preferred, nonconvertible debt, nonconvertible preferred), 1974-1985

dv.name: abnormal return
dv.measure: value-weighted portfolio abnormal return (index-model prediction error) over the 60-day preannouncement period, with aggregate and median z-statistics

key_ivs.name: going-private buyout announcement
key_ivs.measure: preannouncement window defined relative to appearance of buyout announcement in the Wall Street Journal

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]

dv.name: abnormal return
